name: customer-review
title: Customer revenue review
for_each: select id,name from customers order by name

sections.title: Monthly history
sections.sql: select month,currency,prior_mrr,mrr,change,movement from v_movements where customer_id=$1 order by month

sections.title: Follow-up work
sections.sql: select title,owner,due_on,status,evidence from actions where customer_id=$1 order by due_on

sections.title: Review notes
sections.sql: select body,actor,created_at from notes where customer_id=$1 order by created_at

name: reconciliation-record
title: Month-end reconciliation record
for_each: select id,month::text||' '||currency as name from month_reviews

sections.title: Recorded evidence
sections.note: Historical signoff. Run signoffs to check whether the current figures still match.
